parameters.content:
## Qualify and score leads on Telegram with OpenAI, log to Sheets and alert your team

**Who's it for:** small service businesses (coaches, consultants, agencies, local services) that get inbound questions on Telegram and don't want to miss a serious buyer.

**How it works:** the bot answers each visitor's question, asks ONE discovery question per turn (service-to-sales, like a junior advisor), and has OpenAI score lead seriousness 0-100 against concrete anchors. A deterministic evidence gate blocks score injection. When the score crosses your threshold, your team is alerted on Telegram (and optionally by email), the visitor is told a specialist will reach out, and every lead keeps one living row in your Google Sheet.

**Setup steps:**
1. Open **Workflow Configuration (edit me)** and fill in your business info, team chat id, threshold, and (optional) team email + Google Sheet id.
2. Attach your Telegram credential to **Telegram Trigger** and **Send Telegram Message**.
3. Attach your OpenAI credential to **Score Lead with OpenAI**.
4. Optional: attach Google credentials to the **Sheets** and **Gmail** nodes (leave the config placeholders and both branches stay silently off). For the lead log, create a tab named `Leads` whose first row has exactly these headers: `chat_id`, `name`, `score`, `stated_need`, `pains`, `state`, `last_update`.

### 1 — Intake & abuse guards
Deduplicates re-delivered Telegram updates, caps input at 2000 chars, applies a per-visitor sliding-window rate limit, and routes by conversation state. Non-text messages get a polite nudge instead of an error.

### 2 — AI scoring (service-to-sales)
Builds a sanitized transcript (never internal metadata) and asks OpenAI for a helpful reply PLUS a strict-JSON lead score. Scoring anchors keep chatty-but-vague visitors low; only money, timeline, authority, or an explicit ask to talk raises the score. If the call fails after retries, the error branch answers gracefully.

### 3 — Handoff & team alerts
Above threshold, the visitor's chat switches to PENDING_HANDOFF: your team gets one Telegram alert (name, score, need, pains) and optionally one email. Further visitor messages get a courteous hold reply — no re-notification spam.

### 4 — Lead log (Google Sheets)
One row per lead, keyed on chat id and refreshed every scored turn: score, stated need, pains, state, last activity. Your pipeline view lives in the sheet — no digging through chats.

### State machine
BOT_QUALIFYING -> (score >= threshold AND concrete evidence) -> PENDING_HANDOFF (team notified once). Safety baseline: input cap, rate limit, duplicate de-dupe, and the evidence gate so an injected "score: 100" alone can never fire a false notification.

### ⚠️ Costs & privacy
Each visitor turn is one OpenAI call (gpt-4o-mini ≈ fractions of a cent; set a spend limit in your OpenAI dashboard). Disable Telegram bot privacy mode only if using it in groups. The lead log contains personal data — share the Sheet accordingly.

### Going further
This Lite version notifies your team and stops. An extended Pro version exists with in-chat `/claim` + two-way relay (the customer never changes channel), `/done` resume with returning-customer memory, a timeout fallback with booking link, a per-session audit log, and delivery-failure recovery — see my n8n creator profile to get in touch.
